items.description: Every exported class, interface, service method, controller endpoint, and public utility must contain a TSDoc block comment.
Names must self-describe business purpose without single-letter variables (except i, j in loops).
Functions must not exceed 35 lines of executable logic; decompose complex logic into focused helper functions.
Functions must accept at most 3 positional parameters; functions requiring 4+ inputs must use a typed DTO.
Never nest if/else blocks deeper than 2 levels. Validate preconditions and return or throw immediately.
Explicit 'any' is strictly forbidden. Use unknown, generics, discriminated unions, or utility types.
All status codes, roles, and constant thresholds must be defined using TypeScript enums or readonly constant objects.
